scope.fixture: Exactly the named two cards in hand; remaining fixed preset in deck; opponent has no opening hand
scope.turn: First player turn including end-phase decisions, until the next turn
scope.draws: Any first-turn DRAW ends the branch before another response; no outcome or continuation is explored
scope.drawBoundary: The triggering response may resolve DRAW before the core returns; its resulting board is never scored or exported
scope.completeness: completeWithinNoDrawScope means no unresolved in-scope prefix remains; it does not cover draw continuations, interference, or five-card hands
scope.best: Highest openingScore among visited Main 1 decision points, not a proven global optimum or measured win rate
scope.ordering: Kernel DFS within a slice; shorter pending prefixes are visited first on the next slice; no branch is discarded by ordering
